newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Sept 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Sept 5.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Thursday:
* U.S. President Bill Clinton claims success and asserts most Iraqi troops have left Kurdish enclaves.
* American diplomats tried to head off Iraqi incursion into enclave.
* Overcrowded schools open in New York.
* New York opens its first all-girls public school in a decade.
* Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu meets Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat.
* Former Clinton business partner is held in contempt in Whitewater case.
* Republican presidential candidate Bob Dole built his Senate reputation as a master of special tax breaks.
